'''Starpoint''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Draenell's Point]]. Located on the continent of [[Mee'r]], It was home to a population of three million.<ref name="GK" /> It was also the home of the ''[[Farmer's Folly]]'' [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].<ref name="BB" />
